stem: Meera's mother serves her a meal of dal, paneer, chapati and rice. Meera says, "Dal and paneer help my muscles grow and my body develop properly." Which component of food is Meera talking about?

options.text: Proteins, which are needed for muscle building, proper growth and development
Fats, which only store energy in the body
Vitamins, which mainly protect the body from diseases

teacher.key_rationale: Dal and paneer are protein-rich foods from plant and animal sources; proteins are the food components needed for muscle building, proper growth and development, so B is correct.
